description: Redesign the detection system for AI tools and IDEs to eliminate false positives. Introduces typed DetectionConfig with OR-of-ANDs evaluation, 5 detection mechanisms (binary, directory, app bundle, VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin), and removes the legacy detection field.

userStories.title: Implement binary check mechanism
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a checkBinary() function that looks up a binary in PATH and optionally verifies its identity via version output to prevent binary name collisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new file packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.ts
Implement and export checkBinary(check: BinaryCheck): Promise<boolean>
Uses 'which' command on darwin/linux, 'where' command on win32 for binary lookup
If platforms is specified and process.platform is not in the list, returns false
If binary not found in PATH, returns false
If no versionPattern provided, returns true when binary exists
If versionPattern provided, runs '<name> <versionFlag>' (default '--version') with 5-second timeout
Returns true only if version output matches versionPattern regex
Handles command timeout gracefully by returning false without throwing

Unit tests in packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.test.ts covering: binary exists no pattern (true), binary not found (false), version matches (true), version mismatch/collision (false), platform mismatch (false), win32 uses 'where', timeout returns false
All child_process and fs calls are mocked in tests (no real I/O)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement directory check mechanism
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a checkDirectory() function that verifies a directory exists and optionally contains a marker file, preventing false positives from leftover empty directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement and export checkDirectory(check: DirectoryCheck): Promise<boolean> in packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.ts
Expands ~ to os.homedir() in the path
If platforms is specified and process.platform is not in the list, returns false
Checks directory existence with fs.access(path, fs.constants.R_OK)
If no markerFile specified, returns true when directory exists
If markerFile specified, checks that the file or subdirectory exists inside the directory using fs.access(path.join(dir, markerFile))
Returns false when directory exists but marker file is missing (leftover directory detection)
Unit tests covering: dir exists no marker (true), dir not found (false), dir + marker exist (true), dir exists marker missing (false), platform mismatch (false), tilde expansion works
All fs calls are mocked in tests
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement VS Code extension check mechanism
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a checkVscodeExtension() function that checks for installed extensions in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf extension directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement and export checkVscodeExtension(check: VscodeExtensionCheck): Promise<boolean> in packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.ts
Maps editor names to extension directories: vscode -> ~/.vscode/extensions/, cursor -> ~/.cursor/extensions/, windsurf -> ~/.windsurf/extensions/
Defaults to ['vscode'] if editors not specified in the check
Reads directory listing with fs.readdir and looks for entries starting with extensionId (case-insensitive comparison)
Returns true on first match across any editor's extension directory
Handles missing extension directories gracefully (ENOENT -> skip, not throw)
Unit tests covering: extension found by prefix match (true), extension not installed (false), checks multiple editors finds in second (true), extension directory missing (false without error)
All fs calls are mocked in tests
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement JetBrains plugin check mechanism
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a checkJetbrainsPlugin() function that scans JetBrains IDE config directories for installed plugins.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement and export checkJetbrainsPlugin(check: JetbrainsPluginCheck): Promise<boolean> in packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.ts
Locates JetBrains config base per platform: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/, Linux ~/.config/JetBrains/, Windows process.env.APPDATA + /JetBrains/
Reads the base directory to get IDE version directories (e.g. IntelliJIdea2025.1)
For each version directory, checks <version>/plugins/ for a subdirectory matching pluginId
Returns true on first match across any IDE version
Handles missing JetBrains config base directory gracefully (returns false, no throw)
Unit tests covering: plugin found across versions (true), no JetBrains config (false), config exists but plugin not installed (false)
All fs calls are mocked in tests
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement detection evaluation engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an evaluateDetection() function that evaluates a DetectionConfig using OR-of-ANDs logic so that detection groups are composable.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement and export evaluateDetection(config: DetectionConfig): Promise<boolean> in packages/core/src/detection/mechanisms.ts

Implement internal runCheck(check: DetectionCheck): Promise<boolean> dispatcher that routes to checkBinary, checkDirectory, checkAppBundle, checkVscodeExtension, or checkJetbrainsPlugin based on check.type
All groups evaluated in parallel using Promise.all
Within each group, ALL checks must pass (AND logic via results.every(Boolean))
ANY group passing means installed (OR logic via groupResults.some(Boolean))

Unit tests covering: single group single check passes (true), single group fails (false), multiple groups any passes (true/OR), no groups pass (false), group with multiple checks all pass (true/AND), group with multiple checks one fails (false/AND), mixed groups (true)
Tests mock the individual check functions rather than filesystem calls
Typecheck passes
